meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: Claude 会分析你提供的文本,按 12 个认知维度各打 1–10 分,并给出张力图、主导与阴影模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹、叙事总结和关键引文。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某人如何思考、分析写作或说话风格、比较不同人的思考风格,或提到「认知画像」「思维模式」「DHDNA」等词时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字作者的思维方式和决策风格
say.note: 输出 12 维度打分与完整画像

say.text: 把我和这位作者的文字放一起,对比思维差异
say.note: 先各出一份画像,再做对比综合

say.text: 用我们这段对话给我自己做一份认知画像
say.note: 基于对话打分,并说明其局限

howto.what_en: Claude scores any text on 12 cognitive dimensions (1–10) and returns a tension map, dominant and shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, narrative synthesis and key quotes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask how someone thinks, want writing or speech patterns profiled, compare thinking styles, or mention "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern" or "DHDNA".

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking and decision style of this text's author
say_en.note: Returns 12 dimension scores plus full profile

say_en.text: Compare my writing with this author's and show how our thinking differs
say_en.note: Two profiles then a comparison synthesis

say_en.text: Profile my own thinking from this conversation
say_en.note: Scores the chat and notes its limits
